_about: Decision pages kept out of the run-up study, each with its reason. 35 are pages whose cited primary source was re-read on 2026-11-18 and does not support the FDA action on the page date: verify_decisions.py (2026-08-12) accepted any SEC filing within 14 days containing "approval of", "FDA approval" or "complete response letter"; 82 pages rested on such a match and 35 did not hold up (shareholder votes, warrants, financing papers, earnings recaps, a Phase 2 data release). Two are a second page for one FDA action (IRON-2026-02-15, VNDA-2026-02-21) and one is dated days after the action it reports (SNY-2025-12-28), so its price window starts after the news. Remove an entry only with a source that states the action on that date; a page re-dated to the true action date gets a new id and enters the study on its own. Entries for dates before 2025 are rows of the 2020 to 2024 research set, which has no decision pages; they are keyed the same way.
